title: Do Senior Agents Do Their Job? Measuring Role Integrity in How LLM Agents Use Subordinate Material
abstract: arXiv:2611.27139v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly divide long tasks among subagents whose reports a senior agent turns into the final answer. Such a division of labor pays off only if each agent, and above all the senior agent, carries out the duties of its role. Current evaluations, however, mostly score the final answer, and a fluent, well-cited answer cannot show whether the senior agent weighed its subagents' reports or merely aggregated them. To assess whether a senior agent meets its assigned responsibilities, we define role integrity as the preservation of an agent's functional responsibilities when it acts on its subordinates' material. To measure it, we introduce RI-Bench, a behavioral benchmark grounded in the structures and public records of three institutional hierarchies: peer review, appellate adjudication, and parliamentary inquiry. translated_title: 高级智能体尽到职责了吗？衡量LLM智能体使用下级材料时的角色完整性
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统日益将长任务分配给多个子智能体，再由高级智能体将其报告整合为最终答案。这种分工只有在每个智能体——尤其是高级智能体——履行其角色职责时才能奏效。然而，当前的评估大多只对最终答案进行打分，而一个流畅、引用规范的答案无法表明高级智能体是否真正权衡了其子智能体的报告，还是仅仅进行了简单汇总。为了评估高级智能体是否履行了其被赋予的职责，我们将“角色完整性”定义为智能体在处理其下级材料时对其功能职责的保持。为了衡量这一概念，我们提出了RI-Bench，这是一个基于三种制度层级的结构与公开记录的行为基准：同行评审、上诉裁决和议会调查。我们选择这些层级，是因为它们的规则明确赋予高级角色对下级材料的职责。
tldr: 该论文提出“角色完整性”概念并构建RI-Bench行为基准，借助同行评审、上诉裁决和议会调查三种制度层级的结构与公开记录，衡量多智能体LLM系统中高级智能体是否真正履行了权衡下级报告的职责，而非仅仅进行简单汇总。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "role integrity" and presents RI-Bench, a behavioral benchmark grounded in three institutional hierarchies—peer review, appellate adjudication, and parliamentary inquiry—to measure whether senior LLM agents genuinely fulfill their duty of weighing subordinates' reports rather than merely aggregating them.
